hml_meaning: Aruka_HML protected Supabase project ref used only as a local/HML guardrail; isolated CI must use an ephemeral project id and must not preserve the protected HML project ref.
isolated_ci_setup: PASS_FOR_HML_CONTRACT; local simulation reached expected=false actual=false assertion_passed=true and then stopped on the separate Docker context guardrail
root_cause: The clean worktree producer treated an empty supabase/.temp/project-ref as HML project-ref preservation. Empty ref is acceptable local safety state, but in isolated CI it must mean HML preservation=false.
